```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(effects)
```


```{r}
plot_theme <- theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"), 
                     panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
                     panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
                     plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), 
                     axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1), 
                     axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1), 
                     axis.minor.ticks.length = rel(0.75),
                     axis.text = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"), 
                     axis.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"), 
                     text = element_text(size = 20), 
                     plot.title = element_text(size = 20), 
                     axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
                     axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 5)), 
                     plot.margin = unit(c(5, 8, 5, 5), "mm"), 
                     legend.text = element_text(size = 12), 
                     legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
                     legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
                     axis.ticks.length = unit(0.3, "cm"), 
                     strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey", color = "black"), 
                     panel.spacing = unit(3, "mm"))
```


```{r}
#read in data for figure 2, broodstock and juvenile releases

brood_releases <- read_xlsx("data/Data needed - JCAPE.xlsx", sheet = "Main Body Figure 2")

juv_release <- brood_releases[, 1:5]
broodstock <- brood_releases[, 7:10]

colnames(juv_release) <- c("year", "group", "lifestage", "origin", "abundance")

table(juv_release$lifestage)
table(juv_release$origin)
table(juv_release$group)

juv_release_summary <- juv_release %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(abundance = sum(abundance))

juv_release_plot <- ggplot(juv_release_summary, aes(x = year, y = abundance)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#0d0887", color = "black", width = 0.7) + 
  plot_theme + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 150000)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(1997, 2025), breaks = seq(1998, 2024, 2),
                     guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
  ylab("Juvenile releases") + 
  xlab("Year")

head(broodstock)
colnames(broodstock) <- c("year", "hat_brood", "nat_brood", "total_brood")

broodstock_plot <- ggplot(broodstock, aes(x = year, y = total_brood)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#0d0887", color = "black", width = 0.7) + 
  plot_theme + 
  xlab("Year") + 
  ylab("Broodstock collected") + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 150)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(1997, 2025), breaks = seq(1998, 2024, 2),
                     guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) 

ggarrange(broodstock_plot + ggtitle("A"), juv_release_plot + ggtitle("B"), 
         align = "hv", ncol = 1)  
```

```{r}
nosa <- read_xlsx("data/Data needed - JCAPE.xlsx", sheet = "Main Body Figure 5", skip = 2)
head(nosa)

colnames(nosa) <- c("population", "waterbody", "year", "agency", "method", "nosaij", "lcl", "ucl")

table(nosa$waterbody)
table(nosa$population)

nosa <- nosa %>%
  mutate(treatment = if_else(waterbody == "Johnson Creek", "treatment", "control"), 
         time = if_else(year <= 2000, "pre", 
                        if_else(year >= 2006, "post", "interim"))) %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  mutate(nosa_scaled = scale(nosaij))


#plot nosaij for Johnson Creek
jc_plot <- nosa %>%
  filter(waterbody == "Johnson Creek") %>%
  mutate(time = fct_relevel(time, "post", after = 2), 
         time = fct_relevel(time, "interim", after = 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = nosaij)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lcl, ymax = ucl, color = time), width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.75) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 21, aes(fill = time)) + 
  plot_theme + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1986, 2020), breaks = seq(1985, 2020, 5), 
                     minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2020, 1),
                     expand = c(0, 0),
                     guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1200)) + 
  xlab("Year") + 
  ylab("NOSAij") + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Period", labels = c("Pre supplementation", "Early supplementation", "Post supplementation")) + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Period", labels = c("Pre supplementation", "Early supplementation", "Post supplementation"))

#plot raw NOSA for all streams
nosa_raw_plot <- ggplot(nosa, aes(x = year, y = nosaij)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = waterbody, linetype = treatment, alpha = treatment), linewidth = 1) + 
  plot_theme + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1986, 2025), breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 5), 
                     minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 1),
                     expand = c(0, 0),
                     guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1500), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2, 1), name = "Treatment") + 
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.5, 1), name = "Treatment") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Population") + 
  xlab("Spawn year") + 
  ylab("Natural origin spawner abundance")

#plot scaled NOSA for all streams
nosa_scaled_plot <- ggplot(nosa, aes(x = year, y = nosa_scaled, group = waterbody)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = treatment, alpha = treatment, linetype = treatment), linewidth = 1) + 
  plot_theme + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1986, 2025), breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 5), 
                     minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 1),
                     expand = c(0, 0),
                     guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 3), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) + 
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2, 1), name = "Treatment", labels = c("Control", "Treatment")) + 
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.6, 1), name = "Treatment", labels = c("Control", "Treatment")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#5ec962", "#3b528b"), name = "Treatment", labels = c("Control", "Treatment")) + 
  ylab("Scaled NOSA") + 
  xlab("Year") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1998, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2006, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30")

#scaled NOSA with points and median
nosa_scaled_plot_2 <- ggplot(nosa, aes(x = year, y = nosa_scaled, group = waterbody)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = treatment), size = 4, alpha = 0.3) + 
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "line", aes(group = treatment, color = treatment), linewidth = 1) +
  plot_theme +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1986, 2025), breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 5), 
                     minor_breaks = seq(1985, 2025, 1),
                     expand = c(0, 0),
                     guide = guide_axis(minor.ticks = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 3), expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#5ec962", "#3b528b"), name = "Treatment", labels = c("Control", "Johnson Creek")) + 
  ylab("Scaled NOSA") + 
  xlab("Year") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1998, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2006, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 1)

```



```{r}
hist(nosa$nosaij)
hist(log(nosa$nosaij))
hist(nosa$nosa_scaled)

#analyze log-transformed nosaij

baci_dat <- nosa %>%
  filter(time != "interim") %>%
  filter(year >= 1987 & year <= 2018) %>% #filter to years with data for JC
  mutate(log_nosa = log(nosaij+1))

lmm.1 <- lmer(log_nosa ~ treatment * time + (1|waterbody), data = baci_dat)
summary(lmm.1)

lmm.2 <- lmer(log_nosa ~ time*treatment + (1|waterbody+year), data = baci_dat)
summary(lmm.2)


baci_summary <- baci_dat %>%
  group_by(treatment, time) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(nosaij, na.rm = T), se = (sd(nosaij, na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(nosaij))))

#mean by group and time period
#add confidence intervals
baci_summary %>%
  mutate(time = as.factor(time)) %>%
  mutate(time = fct_relevel(time, "post", after = 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = mean)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-se, ymax = mean+se, color = treatment), linewidth = 1, width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = treatment), shape = 21, size = 5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  plot_theme + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#5ec962", "#3b528b"), name = "Treatment", labels = c("Control", "Johnson Creek")) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#5ec962", "#3b528b"), name = "Treatment", labels = c("Control", "Johnson Creek")) + 
  ylab("Mean NOSAij") + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Pre", "Post")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 600), expand = c(0, 0))


#plot predicted model output
lmm_predict <- predict(lmm.2, newdata = baci_summary[, 1:2], re.form = NA, se.fit = T)
baci_summary <- cbind(baci_summary, lmm_predict)

baci_summary <- baci_summary %>%
  mutate(fit.lcl = fit - 1.96*se.fit, 
         fit.ucl = fit + 1.96*se.fit)

baci_summary %>%
  mutate(time = as.factor(time)) %>%
  mutate(time = fct_relevel(time, "post", after = 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = exp(fit))) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = exp(fit - 1.96*se.fit), ymax = exp(fit + 1.96*se.fit), color = treatment), linewidth = 1, width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  geom_point(aes(fill = treatment), shape = 21, size = 5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  plot_theme + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#5ec962", "#3b528b"), name = "Treatment", labels = c("Control", "Johnson Creek")) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#5ec962", "#3b528b"), name = "Treatment", labels = c("Control", "Johnson Creek")) + 
  ylab("Predicted NOSAij") + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Pre", "Post"))
```
